NDT software in Baton Rouge: built for the Mississippi River chemical corridor

If you run an NDT or inspection company in Baton Rouge, your work is shaped by the river. The ExxonMobil Baton Rouge refinery and chemical plant sit on the north side of the city, Dow Louisiana Operations and Shintech are across the river in Plaquemine, and the Geismar and Gonzales cluster in Ascension Parish holds some of the densest concentrations of chemical units in the country, including BASF and Methanex. Placid Refining runs in Port Allen. Down the corridor toward New Orleans there are dozens more chemical and fertilizer sites, and most of them buy inspection from contractors based between Baton Rouge and Gonzales.

The typical Baton Rouge NDT contractor is not a giant. It is a company with somewhere between a handful and a few dozen technicians, a radiography crew or two licensed through the Louisiana Department of Environmental Quality radiation program, a UT and PAUT group, and a lot of PMI, hardness and PT work on alloy piping. Work comes in waves: steady routine inspection most of the year, then turnaround season when every plant wants three more crews by Monday. The Atlantis ERP solution is set up for exactly that shape of business, and this page walks through how each part of it applies to inspection work in the Baton Rouge area.

ERP for NDT companies in Baton Rouge: what it actually covers

An ERP for NDT companies in Baton Rouge needs to hold technician certifications, instrument calibration, crew dispatch, method-specific reports, procedures, quotes and invoices in one system, so a plant auditor or a customer's QA group can trace any report back to a qualified person and a calibrated instrument. The Atlantis ERP does that, and it is configured to your company during implementation rather than sold as a generic package.

Most Baton Rouge contractors we talk to are running a mix of spreadsheets, a shared drive of Word report templates, a separate accounting package and a whiteboard for crew assignments. That works until a turnaround, when the whiteboard is out of date by lunchtime and nobody is sure whether the PAUT unit going to Geismar has a current calibration certificate. The Atlantis ERP brings those pieces together: Certificates, Asset Management, Team Assignments, NDT Reports, Procedures, Quotations and Invoicing share the same technician, equipment and job records. Enter a technician once and that record drives dispatch, timesheets, report signatures and billing.

Technician certification tracking software for Baton Rouge plant work

Technician certification tracking in Baton Rouge matters because plant owners and their QA contractors check qualifications before a technician gets through the gate, and a lapsed cert found during an audit can pull a whole crew off a unit. The Atlantis ERP records each certification with scheme, level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, and computes the status automatically as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked.

For a corridor contractor, that means a Level II in UT and MT under your SNT-TC-1A written practice, the same technician's CP-189 or ISO 9712 record if a client asks for it, their OJT and training hours, exam results and the supporting attachments all live on one employee record. Vision tests are tracked separately, with near vision (Jaeger J1/J2), colour perception and contrast results, the examiner and clinic, and an expiry date. The employee NDT profile also holds radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, which is exactly what your radiation safety officer needs to see before assigning someone to an RT crew.

Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days before a cert or vision test expires, and configurable email alerts go to whoever you choose. Timesheets warn when someone logs hours against a method their certificate does not currently cover, so problems surface on Tuesday, not during the client's audit.

Calibration management software for instruments on corridor jobs

Calibration management software for Baton Rouge NDT companies should tell you, before a truck leaves the yard, whether every flaw detector, PAUT unit, PMI analyser, hardness tester and yoke on it is in calibration. The Atlantis ERP tracks every instrument by serial number with calibration frequency, status and certificate records, and warns when out-of-calibration equipment is assigned to a job.

Each calibration record captures the provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, whether the lab is accredited, the pass, fail or conditional result and the next due date. The calibration certificate register holds the lab's accreditation number, the PDF and a valid, expiring or expired status with alerts. Equipment moves through an issue and return workflow with supervisor and manager approval, and condition is recorded at both ends, which settles most arguments about who damaged a probe on the last job at Plaquemine.

Consumables are tracked too: couplant, penetrant and developer, magnetic particle bath, PPE and film or plates. Each item has a reorder level and a low-stock flag, so turnaround season does not start with an empty penetrant shelf. The maintenance log records preventive and corrective work, firmware updates and probe replacements with condition before and after.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for Baton Rouge turnarounds

Crew dispatch software for NDT companies in Baton Rouge has to stop double-booking during turnaround season, when the same qualified RT crew is being requested by three plants on the same night. The Atlantis ERP runs each job as a team assignment moving from planned to dispatched to in field to submitted to closed, and it blocks double-booking of both technicians and equipment serial numbers.

Each assignment holds the site GPS coordinates, which helps when the job is at a specific gate or unit inside a large complex, along with mobilisation and demobilisation dates. The technician availability calendar shows assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days, and overlaps are blocked. Time Off requests feed that same calendar, so a technician's approved vacation during a Geismar turnaround shows up before you promise them to a client.

Operations managers get technician status, current assignment, utilisation and next available date in calendar, kanban and list views. On a Friday afternoon you can see which Level IIs are free on Monday, which PMI guns are back from the last job, and which assignments are still waiting on paperwork. The Project app also holds safety induction and work permit fields, useful where every plant has its own orientation and permit system.

NDT reporting software for Baton Rouge inspection work

NDT reporting software in Baton Rouge needs to handle a wide spread of methods because chemical plant work is rarely just one. The Atlantis ERP includes 17 report types, including UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, PAUT, TOFD, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite and PWHT, each with its own numbering sequence and method-specific fields.

For corridor work that matters in practical ways. PMI and hardness reports sit in the same system as the RT and PAUT reports on the same welds. RT reports capture source, technique, IQI type and placement. UT reports carry the probe calibration table, and UT thickness readings are recorded by direction. Weld and job lines record defect type and orientation, and every report carries an overall result: acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks. References to the work order, WPS, drawing, procedure and standard are captured on the report itself.

Reports move from draft to in progress to review to approved to sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a field for the third-party or authorized inspector. If a client insists on their own Excel format, the ERP fills your versioned template automatically by mapping fields to cells. Technicians in units with poor signal use the offline field app, which stores drafts and photos locally and syncs later. For clients who want results in 3D, see Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Procedure control for Baton Rouge Level IIIs

Chemical plant clients along the river increasingly ask to see the procedure behind a report, not just the report. The Atlantis ERP procedure register holds document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and either body text or an uploaded file.

Procedures move through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejection and archive states. Approved revisions are locked, every revision is kept as a snapshot, and approvers get email reminders when something is waiting. An AI-assisted first draft can speed up writing a new procedure, for example a PMI procedure for a new client's alloy verification programme, but your Level III still reviews and approves it. Reports then reference the controlled procedure, which closes one of the more common audit findings for small contractors.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for corridor contractors

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Baton Rouge companies should let you quote a turnaround scope quickly and then bill it the way the plant's accounts payable team expects. The Atlantis ERP quotations carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with NDT service products flagged by method and category, a branded PDF and online acceptance.

Once work starts, timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup hours with method, site, equipment serial and a billable flag and rate multiplier, so night shift and overtime are handled consistently. Invoices carry the NDT project, job or PO number, site and industry sector, with subtotals for labour, equipment and consumables and lines that show method, technician, equipment serial, rate type and days or hours. Field expenses and per diems come through the Expenses app and can be re-billed to the job. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, outstanding invoices and a 12-month view, which is useful for seeing how much of your year turnaround season really is.

Implementation for NDT companies in Baton Rouge

Implementation starts with how you already work. We map your written practice, your cert schemes, your report formats, your existing instrument list and the way your largest clients want invoices, then configure the ERP around that. Excel report templates your plant customers already accept are loaded as company templates, so technicians do not have to learn a new format mid-job.

Data migration usually covers technicians and their certifications, instruments and calibration history, customers and sites, and open jobs. Where a client portal, accounting package or plant maintenance system needs to talk to the ERP, the open REST API connects to SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Anything not built in is configured during implementation. Setup and support come directly from Atlantis NDT, founded by an ASNT NDT Level III, so the people configuring your system understand the difference between a PT dwell time and a PMI grade check.

Timing is worth planning. Most Baton Rouge contractors prefer to go live between turnaround seasons, so the team learns the system on routine work. If you want to talk through timing, ask us about an implementation plan for Baton Rouge.

Affordable customizable ERP for inspection companies in Baton Rouge

An affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Baton Rouge is one that fits a small or mid-sized contractor without forcing you to pay for modules you will never use or change how you work to suit the software. The Atlantis ERP is scoped to your company and priced by quote on request.

For small NDT companies, that often means starting with certificates, asset management, team assignments and NDT reports, then adding quoting, invoicing, CRM and dashboards as the business grows. Dashboards show calibration due and overdue, certs expiring and expired, and issued equipment that is overdue for return, all on one screen. If you also train your own people, the eLearning app provides a Level I, II and III course portal for SNT-TC-1A-based training, and the Practical NDT 3D simulator gives trainees hands-on practice before they go into a unit.

If you want to see it with your own data, book a demo for your Baton Rouge team, or request a quote for your company.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for a Baton Rouge inspection company?

The best NDT software is the one that ties certifications, calibration, dispatch, reports and billing together for how you already work. The Atlantis ERP is built for NDT companies and configured to each contractor, which suits the mixed-method, turnaround-heavy work common along the corridor.

Can the ERP track LDEQ-related radiography records?

The ERP records radiation safety training, radiation badge numbers and medical fitness expiry on each technician, and the Fleet app records whether a vehicle can carry radioactive sources along with its transport licence number and expiry. Any additional regulatory records you need are configured during implementation.

Does it work offline inside a plant?

Yes. The offline field app works without signal, stores drafts and photos locally and syncs when the technician is back in coverage.

Can we keep our clients' report formats?

Yes. Versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML can be loaded, and Excel templates are filled automatically by mapping fields to cells.

Is it suitable for small NDT companies?

Yes. Many Baton Rouge contractors start with the core NDT apps and add others later. Scope and pricing are quote on request.

Can it connect to our accounting system?

The open REST API integrates with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.
